# Generate Changelog Entry

**Context requirements:**
- Feature/fix description and scope
- Issue/PR references
- Breaking changes or migrations
- Testing performed (lint, build, pytest, playwright)

**Prompt structure:**
- Start with bullet or heading per change
- Mention user-facing impact and spatial data implications
- Note CRS/data contract changes explicitly
- Include testing checklist

**Example usage:**
- "Changelog entry for adding new water access layer with CRS validation"
- "Changelog entry for Docker build optimization and Playwright coverage"
